units: Targ. Jer. XVIII, 14 (ed. Wil. מַבּוּעֵי pl.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:27">Targ. Prov. XIV, 27</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:4">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>הא מ׳ וכ׳</he> the well is before thee, drink! (i.e. do what you please, I shall not assist you).
Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ top לית מַבּוּעָן וכ׳ our well does not supply us.—Pl. מַבּוּעִין, מַבּוּעֵי.
